Array sorting and comparators

sort mutates the array and sorts by string representation by default. A comparator returns a
negative, zero or positive value to determine order.

Interview question: Why use (a,b) => a-b in numeric sort?
Answer: The sign of the difference orders numbers numerically instead of lexicographically.
Practice: Sort an array of product objects by descending price.
